content_sections.heading: NIT Delhi Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the NIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the NIT Delhi recruitment is Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 10 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The educational qualification requires an M.Tech./M.E./M.S. by Research or equivalent postgraduate degree with GATE/NET qualification, or a B.Tech./B.E. with a minimum CGPA of 7.5 and a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 32 years, with age relaxation as per GOI norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the JRF post is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA (As per DST Norms) per month.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article, under the "Official Notification PDF" description.
